description: Iteration helper boundary coverage: an empty array visits no items (only the absent return value is reported), a larger array (length 5) is visited fully in order, and a differently-named array yields correctly-named indexed field names. The helper returns no value in every case.

foo[0]=0
foo[1]=1
foo[2]=2

return=undefined
